text: Perdue Farms is a privately held, family-owned agriculture company (fourth-generation Perdue family) with no state ownership.
short: Perdue Farms is a privately held, family-owned agriculture company (fourth-generation Perdue family) with no state ownership.

source.name: Legal Clarity Perdue Farms ownership page
source.quote: Perdue Farms is owned entirely by the Perdue family, who have held the company privately for four generations since Arthur and Pearl Perdue founded it in 1920.
